name: Savannah Sparrow
desc: Savannah Sparrow (Passerculus sandwichensis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 73 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The Savannah sparrow is a small New World sparrow that is the only member of the genus Passerculus. It is a widespread and abundant species that occupies open grassland habitats in North America.
